proves.claim: A gate job whose newest settle step is stale prints a resubmit line, not GATE_WAITING.

cli.logic-show-gate.stale-settle-says-re.why: Without it, show tells builders do not resubmit for a gate that died when the claim moved, and the item stays stuck.

proves.claim: A gate job with no settle step or an unknown one still prints GATE_WAITING.

cli.logic-show-gate.unsettled-gate-still.why: Without it, the stale line could replace a live gate's waiting line and send builders to resubmit into the queue.
